recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast, high-key group portrait of four men in white suits against a stark white background, featuring a prominent geometric logo in the upper left corner. The lighting is blown out in the highlights, causing the white clothing to blend into the background, leaving only the faces, hands, and dark shadows as focal points.
coreVisualRelationships: High-key white-on-white blending of subjects and background
Pyramidal arrangement of four subjects creating depth
Contrast between warm skin tones and cool, sterile white environment
Geometric circular framing of the logo balancing the organic human forms
coreInvariants: Subjects wearing matching white formal attire
Upper-left placement of a circular graphic emblem

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Four subjects arranged in a staggered, tiered formation occupying the lower two-thirds of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The dark, high-contrast faces of the subjects against the white field.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the logo in the top left, moves down to the front-left subject, across to the front-right, and up through the back row.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive white negative space at the top and sides, creating a sense of airy minimalism.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Extreme value contrast with very low saturation except for natural skin tones.

characterSpecificRedesigns: Numbers or letters are sliced horizontally at the baseline
A mirrored or inverted version of the characters appears below a double horizontal line
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single strong display face used as a graphic mark.

preserve: High contrast between thick and thin strokes

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary extreme stroke contrast and verticality.
Offers the elegant, high-fashion serif look required for the 90s R&B aesthetic.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A studio portrait of four men in white suits against a pure white background. Use high-key lighting so the white fabric bleeds into the background. The men should be in a tiered sitting/standing arrangement. High contrast on facial features.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a circular logo in the top left corner. Inside the circle, place large high-contrast serif numbers. The numbers should be bisected by two horizontal lines, with a mirrored/inverted version of the numbers appearing below the lines.

verificationChecks: Do the white suits blend into the background highlights?
Is the logo placed in the upper left?
Does the typography feature extreme thick/thin contrast?

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the white clothing does not have visible outlines against the white background.
Confirm the logo is perfectly circular.
Check that the skin tones look natural and warm despite the high-key lighting.
Verify the typography is sharp and vector-like.
recipe.reuseFormula: High-key studio photography + tiered group posing + white-on-white wardrobe + geometric serif logo overlay.
